How to Obtain: This is one of several items that have a chance to drop from Red Vikorian Beetles during the "Sketterling Temple" event in Corsus dungeons.
Kill 100 bosses (can be done across multiple runs).
Complete the "Rescue the Krall Baby" event in Wuthering Keep or The Wild Reach. Afterward, find and speak with the Krall Mother. She will reward you with this item.
Kill 75 bosses (can be done across multiple runs).
Survive the Barn Siege in the Rural Areas.

Find the Fetid Pools dungeon and obtain an Acid Cleaned Key. To obtain an Acid Cleaned Key, you must find and wear a Rusted Amulet, then crouch in one of the acid pools. Open the second door to loot this item.

This area very rarely spawns within the Sunken Passage or Hidden Sanctum dungeons. When you see a wall with the words "Only the Penitent Man May Pass", crouch and walk towards the wall. The wall should fade away, revealing a secret room where this item can be looted.
Complete both the base game campaign and the Subject 2923 DLC campaign on Hardcore Mode to be rewarded with this amulet. (You do not need to complete both campaigns on the same character.)
Speak with Mudtooth. After exhausting his dialogue, he will give you this item.
Found in the Fetid Pools dungeon.
Complete the "Song of the Doe Puzzle" event to be rewarded with this item. The correct bell sequence is 5-4-3-3-4-1-2-3-2-1.
Complete the Subject 2923 campaign on Hardcore Mode.
Complete "The Risen" event in The Radiant Tomb.
Kill 50 bosses (can be done across multiple runs).
Random drop from the Rural Areas.
Complete the "Warning Totems" event in the Magir's Dirge dungeon. If you complete the event while alerting all of the totems, you will be awarded this item.
Defeat all bosses twice. Alternatively, can be purchased from Whispers for 30,000 Scrap and 300 Glowing Fragments.
